newsitem.title: USA: E-Z Serve sells preferred shrs to Phemus.
newsitem.headline: E-Z Serve sells preferred shrs to Phemus.

text.p: E-Z Serve Corp on Tuesday said it sold 140,000 shares of Series H preferred stock to Phemus Corp, one of its major stockholders.

The company said it used net proceeds of $8.4 million from the sale to redeem all of the 75,656 outstanding shares of its $6.00 convertible preferred stock, Series C, and net proceeds of $5.1 million for general corporate purposes.
E-Z Serve, which owns convenience stores, said it also issued to Phemus warrants representing the purchase of 960,000 shares of its common stock at a nominal exercise price.
